articles.text: LǙXÍNGSHÈ GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN: Tiān gāng liàng nín jiù qǐlai le? Bù duō shuì yìhuǐr?
TRAVEL SERVICE WORKER: You're up so soon after dawn? Don't you want to get some more sleep?
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Bù xiǎng shuì le. Xiàmian yízhàn shi nǎr le?
AMERICAN TOURIST: I don't feel like sleeping. What's the next stop?
LǙXÍNGSHÈ GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN: Jínìng, zhè shi yíge dà zhàn, huǒchē zài zhèr tíng èrshífēn zhōng. Wǒmen kěyi dào zhàntáishang qu sànsan bù.
TRAVEL SERVICE WORKER: Jínìng. It's a big stop. The train will stop there for twenty minutes. We can go out for a walk on the platform.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Jínìng yídài shi yíge zhòngyàode dìqū.
AMERICAN TOURIST: The Jínìng area is an important region.
LǙXÍNGSHÈ GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN: Cóng dìxíngshang kàn, Jínìng běibianr shi dà shāmò, nánbianr shi huángtǔ gāoyuán. Gōngyuán qiánhòu zài zhèige dìqū bù zhīdào yǒuguo duōshǎo cì zhànzhēng.

TRAVEL SERVICE WORKER: As far as terrain is concerned, to the north of Jínìng is a big desert, and to the south is the loess plateau. Before and during the Christian era there have been I-don't-know how many wars in this region.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Xiànzài hépíng le, biānjiāng hé nèidì bú huì yǒu zhànzhēng le.
AMERICAN TOURIST: But now it's at peace. The border regions and the interior won't have any more wars.

LǙXÍNGSHÈ GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN: Nín shuōde duì, Zhōngguó shi yíge duō mínzúde, tǒngyīde shèhuìzhǔyì dà jiātíng, mínzú zhījiānde zhànzhēng dōu yǐjīng shi lìshǐ le. Tīngshuō, zài Xīfāng, zhǒngzú wèntí, mínzú wèntí hái shi hěn máfande wèntí a! Shǎoshù mínzúde shēnghuó hé dìwèi hái hěn chà?

TRAVEL SERVICE WORKER: That's right. China is a unified socialist family made up of many nationalities. War between these groups is already a thing of the past. I hear that in the West, racial and ethnic problems are still very troublesome, and that the living conditions and status of minorities are still very inferior.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Wǒ xiǎng zài yìbǎinián yǐqiánde shíhou, zhǒngzú wèntí shi yíge bǐjiào dàde wèntí, xiànzài qíngkuàng yǐjīng yǒule hěn dàde gǎibiàn.
AMERICAN TOURIST: I think that the race problem was bigger a hundred years ago. The situation has already changed quite a lot.
LǙXÍNGSHÈ GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN: Shì ma?
TRAVEL SERVICE WORKER: Is that so?
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Wǒmende zhèngfǔ yāoqiú zhèngfǔ gōngzuò rényuán děi yǒu yídìng shùliàngde shǎoshù mínzú.
AMERICAN TOURIST: Our government requires that their employees include a certain number of minority individuals.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Zài wǒmende xuéxiàoli duì shǎoshù mínzú yě yǒu tèbiéde bāngzhù.
AMERICAN TOURIST: In our schools minorities are also given special help.
LǙXÍNGSHÈ GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN: Nàme nǐ xiǎng zài jiàoyù shuǐpíng, gōngzuò jīhui, shēnghuó shuǐpíng fāngmiàn shǎoshù mínzúde qíngkuàng dōu gǎishàn le?
TRAVEL SERVICE WORKER: Then as far as levels of education, job opportunities, and standard of living are concerned, do you think that the minority situation has improved in all these areas?

MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Wǒ xiǎng mínzú wèntí, zhǒngzú wèntí yǒu lìshǐde yuányīn, yě yǒu zhèngzhì, jīngjì, wénhuà gèfāngmiànde yuányīn, xǔduō guójiā dōu hái yǒu zhèizhǒng wèntí. Zài Měiguó, wǒmende zhèngfǔ hé rénmín dōu zài nǔlì tígāo shǎoshù mínzúde dìwèi. Shǎoshù mínzúde qíngkuàng yídìng huì yuè lái yuè hǎo.

AMERICAN TOURIST: I think that ethnic and racial problems have historical causes, as well as political, economic, and cultural ones. Many countries still have this kind of problem. In America, our government and people are making an effort to raise the status of our minorities. The situation is sure to get better and better for them.
LǙXÍNGSHÈ GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN: Hǎojíle. Wǒmen dōu xīwang gè mínzúde shēnghuó yuè guò yuè hǎo. Jínìng zhàn dào le, wǒmen xiàqu kànkan ba!
TRAVEL SERVICE WORKER: Great. We all hope that life will improve for all peoples. We've arrived at Jínìng station. Let's get off and have a look around.
MĚIGUÓ YÓUKÈ: Hǎode. Zhèr yǐjīng shi Nèi Ménggǔ le, bǐ Dàtóng lěngde duō, wǒ qù chuān jiàn máoyī jiù lái.
AMERICAN TOURIST: All right. This is already Inner Mongolia, and it's much colder than Dàtóng. I'm going to go put on a sweater and I'll be right back.
LǙXÍNGSHÈ GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN: Hǎode, wǒ zài chēxiāng ménkǒu děng ni.
TRAVEL SERVICE WORKER: Okay. I'll wait for you at the door of this car.
